manipulators.description: capslock double tap = exit mouse mode
wide + h = option + shift + left (select word ahead)
wide + l = option + shift + right (select word after)
wide + i = select whole line to head
wide + cmd + h = option + shift + left (select word ahead)
wide + opt + h = option + shift + left (select word ahead)
wide + cmd + l = option + shift + right (select word after)
wide + opt + l = option + shift + right (select word after)
wide + cmd + j = shift + down x3
wide + opt + j = shift + down x3
wide + cmd + k = shift + up x3
wide + opt + k = shift + up x3
wide + cmd + u = option + up (expand selection)
wide + opt + u = option + up (expand selection)
wide + cmd + i = select whole line to head
wide + opt + i = select whole line to head
wide + cmd + p = option + down (shrink selection)
wide + opt + p = option + down (shrink selection)
option + command + h = option + shift + left (select word ahead)
option + command + j = shift + down x3
option + command + k = shift + up x3
option + command + l = option + shift + right (select word after)
option + command + u = option + up (expand selection)
option + command + i = select whole line to head
option + command + p = option + down (shrink selection)
shift + h = ctrl + shift + tab (prev tab)
shift + u = option + command + hyphen (zoom out)
shift + i = command + shift + ` (prev window within app)
control + i = command + h (hide current window)
shift + o = command ` (next window within app)
shift + p = option + command + equal_sign (zoom in)
control + shift + h = ctrl + shift + tab (prev tab)
control + shift + j = command + tab (next application)
control + shift + k = command + tab (prev application)
control + shift + l = command + tab (next tab)
control + shift + u = option + command + hyphen (zoom out)
control + shift + i = command + shift + ` (prev window within app)
control + shift + o = command ` (next window within app)
control + shift + p = option + command + equal_sign (zoom in)
command + m = delete to line start
option + m = delete a char after
option + n = delete a word after

set_notification_message.text: 🖱 鼠标模式  hjkl 移动 · yuio 滚动 · ⌘ 加速 · ⌥ 减速 · 按住 Tab = 区域定位（右手主键区）· 按住 ` 或 ⌃ = 拖动 · n/⏎ 左键 · m 右键 · a/d 后退前进 · 123/qwe 跳屏 · space/esc 退出
